{{Quote|The Rebels fell back to the capitol building, and their leader, General Camon Udeon, read from a manifesto as his small band of terrorists prepared a last-ditch defense.|[[Imperial HoloVision]]|<ref name="GNN3" />}}
[[General/Legends|General]] '''Camon Udeon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Gerrard V military]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Along with other members of the military, Udeon led a band of [[Gerrard V Rebels|rebels]] in an [[Uprising on Gerrard V|armed insurrection]] on [[Gerrard V]], capturing the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Harazod]]. An [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Task force/Legends|task force]] under the [[Commander/Legends|command]] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Jion Trynn]] was despatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to restore order.

Udeon's small navy was defeated in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], and fierce fighting forced the rebels back to the [[capitol building]] in Harazod. Admiral Trynn offered terms of surrender to Udeon, but the General refused the terms by [[Death/Legends|shooting]] the [[Unidentified Imperial courier|courier]]. Trynn then ordered the orbital bombardment of Harazod's urban center.

Udeon's group was suspected of having ties with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], but Admiral Trynn could not confirm or deny his suspicions until Udeon or other leaders had been captured and interrogated.
